facts.text: 01 NOV 2026 11:23AM by PIB Delhi NVS-03 Mission: Expanding the Horizon of NavIC The Indian Space Research Organisation (ISRO) successfully accomplished the GSLV-F18/NVS-03 mission on 30 October 2026 at 23:51 hours from the Satish Dhawan Space Centre (SDSC), Sriharikota.
The GSLV-F18 launch vehicle injected the Navigation Satellite NVS-03 into a precise Geosynchronous Transfer Orbit (GTO).
Subsequently, first orbit manoeuvre completed on 31 October 2026 at 16:48 hours.
For a conventional GTO, the apogee is approximately 35,786 km above Earth's surface.

items.title: Ministry of Coal to Recognize Outstanding Achievements in Coal and Lignite Mining at Star Rating Awards in Raipur on 2nd November
items.summary: 01 NOV 2026 10:52AM by PIB Delhi The Ministry of Coal will recognise and celebrate exemplary achievements in coal and lignite mining at the Star Rating Awards Ceremony on 2 November 2026 in Raipur, Chhattisgarh.

facts.text: The awards will honour high-performing mines for their achievements across key parameters, including operational efficiency, environmental sustainability, occupational health and safety, technological advancement and responsible resource management.
The Star Rating Policy for Coal Mines provides a structured framework for assessing the performance of coal and lignite mines against a comprehensive set of parameters.
Mines are awarded ratings ranging from five stars to no star following assessment and validation by reviewers appointed by the Coal Controller’s Organisation.
Mines achieving the highest star ratings for the assessment year 2024–25 will be felicitated at the ceremony.

The decline reflects the continued efforts of the Ministry of Coal to enhance domestic coal production, improve availability and strengthen the supply chain, with a view to reducing the country’s dependence on imported coal.
